reviews.name: Havyn S.
reviews.text: Great experience! Bruce was very polite and took the time to go over the detail and the status of my vehicle afterwards. He pays attention to the little things, which is super important. My car looks great.

reviews.text: Bruce’s car detailing service was simply amazing!!! My car was in ROUGH shape from food / drink spills, dirt, etc. I booked the Factory Reset and he made it look brand new. He was extremely detailed, timely, and professional. At the end of …

reviews.name: Dae
reviews.text:
Booked VVM for a “Full Factory Reset.”
Bruce was exceptional! His kindness, work ethic, and attention to detail were unmatched. I will be returning. Thank you again, Bruce for your service!

reviews.name: Tala A.
reviews.text: Bruce was amazing!! I absolutely love the results and the communication was on point! Bruce even drove all the way from Maryland to work on my car! Much appreciated!

reviews.name: Jorge A.
reviews.text: They did such a great job detailing my Audi TT, from the Full Factory Reset and two step paint correction to the interior, I would definitely recommend them any day any time, they took their time with it and the results were great, thank you for driving from Maryland to Ashland. Great customer service as well, respectful and honest!

reviews.name: Eunji Y.
reviews.text: Amazing exterior/interior cleaning!! I will definitely reach out to Bruce and his friend again, and would recommend them to anyone who wants their car completely reset. Thanks guys!

reviews.name: Rodney G.
reviews.text: Got the One-step paint correction & 5 year Ceramic coating service. The best service and work hands down. Car came out looking better than it did from the dealership 🔥 …

reviews.name: Rainito
reviews.text: Love the work. Recently went for an interior cleaning & was blown away from the results. Felt like I had just bought the car off the dealership lot. Will Return for an exterior detail soon. 10/10⭐️

reviews.name: James T.
reviews.text: Super Amazing Job!! Great hire!! You won’t be disappointed!!

reviews.name: Nomi
reviews.text: Love the way the headlights look there’s a huge difference and i absolutely love it. The stains from the seats were pretty much fully removed and the car smells great.
